subject.title: Capistrano Unified School District Board, Trustee Area 6

text: After practicing law, I’ve focused on our family and serving our schools. I’ve taught reading in elementary classrooms, helped families with college planning and applications, served on district curriculum and accreditation committees, and directed elementary school field days and senior nights for high school sports. I currently teach high-school study and life skills classes, previously teaching writing and music. For twenty years, I’ve loved serving in Capistrano Unified. My husband and I raised six children in CUSD, all of whom enjoyed its exceptional Spanish-immersion program. We’re still experiencing the district alongside our youngest. From APs to navigating IEPs, we’ve successfully managed many concerns parents have with their CUSD kids. As a longtime volunteer and current Capistrano Unified parent, I remain deeply invested in every student’s success.

Academic excellence
Strong partnerships with families
Safe schools
Attracting and supporting outstanding teachers.

Classrooms should prepare students for success in college, careers, and life. Keep the focus on learning, not on issues that divide us as neighbors. I am honored to have earned the support of teachers, trustees, and community leaders. As Trustee, I will bring experience, common sense, civility, and collaboration to every decision, always putting students first.

text: As a mom with a K-8 student and a high schooler in Capistrano Unified, I'm committed to ensuring every student, at every level, has a clear path to reach their full potential. I'm running to bring transparent and student-centered leadership to our community. I've been showing up for our youth and our community, focused on building relationships, and listening to families.

My commitment extends to child advocacy. In my role as a former PTA President and as a parent leader, I’ve traveled to Sacramento to advocate directly to legislators about preserving critical mental health services, as well as increasing our public school funding. I'll bring my passionate leadership to district oversight.

As a 12-year small business owner, I have experience in managing resources wisely and balancing a budget. On the board, I'll respect taxpayer dollars by cutting unnecessary overhead and prioritizing the classroom experience.

I believe our district must prepare students for a rapidly changing global economy and job market. I'll advocate for modern coursework in emerging fields, including expanded Career Technical Education (CTE) pathways with apprenticeship options, and more opportunities for students to earn college credits before graduation. This combination will provide our students with academic advantages and professional skills, so they’re exceptionally competitive for college and high-demand careers.

Although my professional background is in science, I believe courses in music and other arts subjects are essential for student engagement. They help build discipline and enrich learning across all areas. I'm committed to protecting our arts and music programs, so our children receive a rich, well-rounded education.

Every child must feel safe to learn at school. Campus security requires foresight, clear protocols, and active listening. But true safety goes well beyond physical security: it also means protecting our students by strengthening anti-bullying initiatives and creating welcoming classrooms. I’ll champion safety plans that value both the overall well-being of students and their physical security.

An effective trustee doesn’t make decisions in a vacuum — they listen to the community. I'll push for clearer, proactive district communications so families are never left in the dark about decisions that affect their children.

I’ll keep political agendas out of our classrooms and board meetings so we can focus on what truly matters: academic standards, safe schools, fiscal accountability, and well-rounded opportunities for every child.
I would be honored to earn your vote. EmmonsForCUSD.com
